title: Phase C — unified LLM planning & deterministic-template removal across every new-Mission ingress
description: Phase C removes the deterministic task-template fallback from makeServePlanner and unifies every new-Mission ingress on the existing asynchronous LLM Planner Pool. serve-planner.ts: reason 'initial' now accepts ONLY persisted plan authority (pinned_plan_tasks or metadata.llm_plan) and throws FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_REQUIRED otherwise; 'replan' requires a configured governed replan provider or throws FAIL_CLOSED_REPLAN_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE; PAIR_MC_TEMPLATE_PLANNER and the TEMPLATE plan_source are gone. business.ts: new shared async prepareDelegatedPlan seam re-derives the canonical enriched bound-mission goal, invokes deps.planExpander (the same pool expander the API preview/submit edge uses), rejects missing expander (FAIL_CLOSED_NO_PLANNER) and absent/empty llm_plan (FAIL_CLOSED_DELEGATED_PLAN_ABSENT); openWorkItem re-proves the plan's delegated_goal_digest inside the dedup transaction (FAIL_CLOSED_DELEGATED_PLAN_GOAL_DRIFT) and pins llm_plan + planner provenance onto the mission — sole bound-mission authority unchanged. objective-operating-loop.ts: openDelegatedChild plans asynchronously after the dispatch authority proof, re-proves authority + objective CAS after the await, then opens with the prepared plan; planner failure propagates, never a fake DISPATCHED. mission-draft.ts: confirmInner claims the draft then plans through the same planExpander — missing dep = typed NO_PLANNER with zero provider calls and durable SUBMITTING claim (retry-safe); pool exhaustion propagates durable attempt evidence. mission-control.ts: tickSchedules requires the expander per due schedule (FAIL_CLOSED_NO_PLANNER recorded as the schedule's own fire error). planner-pool.ts: ONE run-level deadlineMs spans eligibility, INITIAL calls, retries and REASK — expiry throws FAIL_CLOSED_PLANNER_DEADLINE and settles honest TIMEOUT evidence; late results are never winners. cost.ts: canonical planner billing resolution (model profile → executor profile → UNKNOWN, never coerced FREE), atomic pre-call admitPlannerInvocation bound to objective lineage resolved fresh (HELD planner reservations attributed through the delegated work item), settlePlannerInvocation (NO_CALLS → RELEASED, CALLS_MADE → exact settle or COMMITTED-at-reserved), reconcilePlannerInvocations sweeping HELD rows from canonical planner_run evidence only. serve-mission-control.mjs: template bypass env removed; planExpander wired with cost ctx + unified deadline; driver/reconcile startup deferred until planner deps exist. Persisted committed/pinned plans replay byte-identical; legacy plan-less missions terminalize FAILED with durable planning_failure evidence instead of executing a synthesized template. package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml: better-sqlite3 11.10.0 → 12.11.1 — Node v24 is officially supported only from v12; v11.10 workers crashed natively at env teardown (RemoveEnvironmentCleanupHook env!=nullptr assertion, Statement destructor during GC) which made the full Vitest suite non-completable on this platform. No API change (pragma/prepare/transaction/exec semantics identical); PAIR storage behavior unchanged.
